review_description: Compliments to Greg and Ben from Green Choice Electrical.They made every effort in ensuring a job well done.The installation wasn't outsourced to a subcontractor.While other installers declined to remove the disused rooftop hot water panels so that more solar panels could be installed, they did it willingly and it was free of charge.Their quote was very competitive, and their customer service first-rate..

The overall process was very easy through Greenchoice.The installers where polite and professional.All the background paperwork and connections through Western Power and Synergy was done smoothly.Not sure it could've been any easier. Highly recommend Greenchoice Electrical. Thanks guys!

First company to respond.Excellent in all areas.Quoted what I requested, didn’t showboat or try and upsell,Communicated the installation timing clearly.Arrived on time and completed the job in 3 hours and 5 minutes.You could tell these guys knew what they were doing.Explained everything and connected the wi fi and grid.A good cooperative bunch of guys.All together a very pleasurable and professional experience.Have already recommended Green Choice Electrical to a good friend.

The installation was done on my recent reroofed house.The crew took their time, and lifted colourbond and insulation as requiredThe inverter was delivered on a later date, and again installed neatly and quickly.Only complaint overall was they wouldn't accept credit card. I normally pay bills on my credit card, and clear it every quarter
The quote was cheapest and the panel layout design was the most efficient. The installation was quick and professional and the company was local and a delight to deal with.
Provided relevant information with no sales pressure. On time install, neat & clean. Provided updates on issues with energy provider & adapted to suit.Would recommend to anyone.

An effortless process to get our solar installed. From getting quotes to the final install, Green Choice made everything simple and easy for us.They provided the quote in a very timely manner with a lot of detail and answered any questions we had swiftly. Installation day was a great experience, Green choice arrived on time and had everything installed before we knew it and went above and beyond with everythingWe have had a fair few tradies come to our house over the last 12 months to do certain work and Green Choice was by far the nicest and easiest to deal with, while also taking great pride in their work and their service.They also came for a follow up visit to connect our system to our wifi and app and make sure everything was working as it should. Overall a great experience and highly recommend Green Choice…. 11/10.

The whole process was straight forward. The Sales Representative was polite and well-informed. He was able to answer all my questions, as well a providing other important information.The installation went well. Ben and his offsiders were polite, punctual and tidy and completed the installation in less time than expected. All the paperwork for the government subsidy, as well as the grid connection, were organised before the crew left.Green Choice Electrical were able to provide the system I wanted at a much better price than other companies' quotes.I highly recommend this very professional Perth-based family business.

I did not know a lot about Solar Panels etc and talking with Greg was very easy and his info was very helpful. I got other quotes but overall felt better advised from Greg; we struck a good fair deal and Ben did a great job with installation.I gladly and without hesitation would recommend Green Choice Electrical - Greg/Brad for your Solar needsCheers, Vincent - Nov 2024
Very happy with Green Choice. Easy to deal eith, knowledgable and very tidy install. Highly recommend
The entire process was seamless & very efficient . I am very happy with my decision with Green Choice Electrical .

Only installer who offered to inspect the property without trying to lock me into a contract. Price of system was also very competitive.The guys had a good care attitude towards the job & were pro-active with the decision making re invertor location, etc.I strongly recommend this company...........

Sales and quoting was seamless and Greg responded to any additional questions I had on the systems quoted very quickly either through email or phone. It made choosing the right system an easy process.At the time of quoting, the property was still under construction however they were happy to come out to the property and do a prelay and come back later to install the panels once the building construction was complete.Installation was on time and their after sales service was excellent with prompt responses and helpful advice along the way.Overall very happy to recommend Green Solar for your solar panel installation.

We chose the installer based on both a well priced package and the professional attitude I experienced with a phone call discussing our options for the install, as we had a current system to be relocated from house to a garage, as well as a new system install. They were also more than happy to accommodate my needs to split the relocation and new install over some time so I could have roof free of panels for some insulation work done between the two days. The work on site for the 2 days was good with all workers friendly and professional, leaving the site clean and tidy. Once the work was complete one of the guys sat with me at my PC to help complete the configuration of the new PV system on Fronius Solar.web. There are limitations on how Solar.web can display the info of the two separate PV systems however that's a Fronius issue, not the installer.

- Sales/quoting process was really good, had multiple conversations with sales person to get the layout of the panels on my roof and they came out to the property to figure out what would be the best placement.- The installation was quick and well done. They told me the time they would arrive and they were punctual. Started work promptly and finished up quicker than anticipated. The install of the inverter looked clean and the wiring on the racking looked ok from a distance. They me setup my account and connecting me to the consumption monitoring app, but forgot to setup the electricity tariff.- Customer service was always on point since the start. They were quick to reply. They maintained their professionalism even after the installation. As mentioned,they forgot to add the energy tariff, but a quick email and it was promptly resolved. They took care of setting up everything and I had my solar connected to the grid immediately after the installation was done.Really happy with the provider so far
Sales/quoting was very efficient. Managed to book us in within a week.Customer service was great, Greg responded to all my queries promptly.Installation was quick, on time and left no mess behind.

Always great communication.Quality consultationGood education along the wayClear contractingLatest technological solutionBespoke, site-specific panel array designCost efficient focusHassle-free installationAccurate administration.

Green Choice were the only installer brave enough to install the number of required panels on my fairly small double story roof, where other contractors said it wasn’t feasible to fit that many panels. It took Green Choice some extra effort but they fit everything perfectly and to a high quality standard.
The quotation was quick and accurate.  The installation was punctual.

I was initially impressed by the no nonsense non-pushy approach to customer service. My questions were easily and readily answered, system design took into account our needs, and the price being reasonable certainly didn't hurt either. When we encountered a problem with possible installation dates, a few calls to reschedule others freed up a date we could work with without overly inconveniencing others. The installation itself progressed smoothly and efficiently.The system itself is great - we are effectively self sufficient for power from 6am to 5pm daily and that's with a big ducted a/c humming away for 7+ hours each day. Couldnt be happier!

No pushy sale person. Happy to help and answer to all my questions. Work was done in timely manner, nice and clean, no mess left behind.Already recommended to the rest of the family and whoever will ask me

Good communication and was happy to work with me to quote and install a system and size which I was happy with and did not try to push particular products like some of the other companies.Install went well without any complaints.Pricing was very competitive and their comms and work ethic was great. Overall very happy to recommend them.

We decided to beef up our solar as the old system was only 3 kw and our power bills were still substantial. We upgraded the existing single phase power to 3 phase so we could install an 8.2 kw Fronius Inverter with 10.66 kw of REC Alpha 410W solar modules. This was about as big a system as we could fit on our roof and leave room for a future solar hot water.There was no requirement for a deposit which was nice, and the job went as smoothly as you can hope given its proximity to Christmas and everyone wanting things done yesterday. There was a delay in the inverter supply so the panels and supporting wiring went in 5 hours one day and the inverter the following week.We paid extra for the Fronius smart meter and the WiFi was not perfect to start with (too many brick walls) but we installed a WiFi extender inside the house close to the inverter and it seems to be going OK. Initially, the smart meter did not monitor the grid connection so you only see the inverter output, but after I contacted the installer, they came around and fixed the problem so it now shows, solar production, consumption by the house and power to/from the grid.Having got an email from Finn after the install with a checklist of paperwork that should be included with the install, I can see room for improvement with Green Choice Electrical on this front. Our previous installation had everything in one envelope which was great whereas I am about to start chasing the bits down to pull this together myself. They have emailed most things but it would be nice if it was all bundled together.We went for a biggish inverter as we plan to install a battery and management system in 2023 to make sure we have lights during future outages that seem more likely and to reduce our power bills to grid connection fees only.As we lost the rooftop pool heater matt, we have also installed a Madimack heat pump (17KW) which will use an additional 0.3 - 2.5 kw.  The plan is to look at full electrification of the house (induction hotplate) and solar hot water heater) in the future.

Staff were extremely helpful and patient with our many questions. Installers arrived at the exact time and on the day they said they would. They were professional, helpful, courteous and willing to answer all our questions. They left our home clean and tidy and took away any rubbish. They carried out all necessary paperwork to ensure we were connected and made sure we were WiFi connected to the system app.
The salesman was straightforward, the installation was OK, the installer was polite and discussed the process with me, customer service was good.  The grid connection was done promptly.
Very detailed and comprehensive quote.(3 options)Accurate solar panel layout before install and asked where we would like the position of inverter.Very good customer service before and after install.

The installer maintained good communication throughout, ensuring a smooth process from quotation through to job completion. The installation itself was highly efficient, and the resulting work is tidy. Follow up support was offered to ensure grid connection and all questions were answered about the system installed.
Everything was done pretty quickly with minimal disruption. They’ve also been responsive afterwards when I stuffed something up!

We were happy with Green Choice Electrical right from the beginning.Polite and friendly and not pushy at all.Everything was as they quoted and on time as well.We found them very helpful and efficient.
Job well done. Efficient workers completed in a timely manner. Very well executed stalled - neat and time tidy.

All works as expected. The 2 young installers were very polite and easy to talk to. seems like a good company I have recommended to others.It was nice to talk directly to the owner of the company rather than a call room
Great customer service with Greg by phone and emails, installation by Ben and 1 other trouble free and even asked where I wanted the inverter to be placed.
Very easy quoting process, followed by smooth installation, WIFI link up & grid connection by Green Choice Electrical
Good quality at a very competitive price.Quick and efficient service.knowledgeable and friendly service.Highly recommended.
Very easy to deal with. Arrived at 7am on the button as promised. Installation team were a great bunch of young guys. Very polite and with the threat of rain, installation went very fast.
Response was good and punctual , didn’t take long to set the installation day
Thoroughly happy I proceeded with Ben and greg at green choice electrical.Communication, workmanship and after sales support flawless. These guys take pride in what they do

Ben, Greg, and the team were very knowledgeable and quoted us a very competitive price for a good quality system. On the day, the team showed up on time, and were incredibly efficient. We were also very impressed with the quality of their workmanship. Would highly recommend this family business. Our solar system is working perfectly!

Long established smaller local company. Quote was prompt. Sales follow up was contactable and helpful.Grid connection was organised for me and fees were included in the installation.Installation was on time. Neat job.

This company was installing solar next door when i approached them.The quoting process was great, no pressure selling and happy to supply more than one quote for different combinations etc.The installation was very punctual, installers were very polite and efficient, tidy and polite. Explained the operating of the system after completing the installation

Quoting process was fast, efficient and detailed and a balanced view of most appropriate solution to fit my needs was provided. The installation was carried out within two months of receiving a quote and was completed by professional and experienced tradesmen who done an excellent job. Customer service following installation was good and I was given guidance on how to apply for Fronius' 5 year extension warraty.
As above, fair pricing, great system, exceptional installation and service through out the process.
Green Choice were very well priced and responded to all my queries. Ended up being such an easy experience, my next door neighbours got their solar done too

The quote process was really great with regular and prompt communication, happy with the quote.The installers were prompt, very professional and friendly with great knowledge of the panels and inverter.Green Choice Electrical organised the grid install with Western Power, I didn't have to do anything.  They also connected my inverter to the Fronius app which was appreciated.Would definitely recommend Green Choice Electrical to anyone.

Very responsive to all emails, all staff were polite, installation was quick and looks good, and the value for system quality was better than other quotes received.They also helped chase up an issue with solar analytics and resolved this quickly.Would highly recommend.

Fitted me in only a few days after coming to site.  Went with Fronius inverter and Trina Vertex S+ panels.  Price was well below competition.  Good to have family run business keeping installation in house.
Very friendly people, extremely easy process and very knowledgeable. Install was very quick and stress free. Would highly recommend.

After receiving the quotes, I  chose Green Choice Electrical as they offered what I was after at a terrific price. They were wonderful to deal with - professional, reliable and answered all my questions. The whole process was so much easier than I thought it would be - I really wished I had done it sooner.
The sales person was very "REAL" , no hidden extras and offered a complete package , start to finish. The installation was prompt, efficient and very tidy, also very nice and polite young men.
They were polite, efficient and set up and instructed me on grid connection.

I didn't need to look any further after meeting Ben and Greg. Their knowledge and expertise was evident and they didn't push or press for the sale. Polite and friendly, I was comfortable with them from the start.I live in a rural area and expected there would be a delay for their visit to quote. This wasn't case. Ben and Greg were out within a matter of days and on a weekend too! I was amazed they gave up their personal time to come out and quote.My questions were answered clearly and the process explained so it was easy to understand.Their quote was competitive and a pleasant surprise. Install date was within 4 weeks.Greg kept me informed throughout, not once did I have to follow up or felt left in the dark. Very reliable and true to their word. They put the customer first.As far as the installation is concerned, Ben and his team did a fantastic job. The day was stress free for me, the guys got immediately to work and had everything in hand. When you see the installation of the panels and the inverter, you see the high quality of workmanship.  Neat and straight, all looking and working as it should. Ben and his team clearly take pride in their work and I couldn't be happier.For anyone considering solar,I definitely recommend contacting Greg and Ben.Green Choice Electrical just gets it so right - from start to finish.

Was given a quote for what I wanted within the first day and was given all the information I could need with absolutely no pushy sales. Greg and Ben were very easy to deal with and the price was better than expected for good quality components. Ben set up the app for us which is brilliant and basically there was nothing for us to do but say yes. And no deposit was needed, payment after installation. They don't use subcontractors either which was important to me. Would recommend.

Out of the three quotes we arranged Green Choice Electrical's site visit and quoting process was very professional.  We had plenty of interaction between Installer and us to ensure we picked the right system for our needs.  Everything was completed within days from the Electrician coming in on the Friday to install electrics to the shed and Green Choice turning up on the Monday to install, all was completed in a morning.  As we had a prior system we were already grid ready but Synergy had to update meter which was completed on the Tuesday.We would also like to thank Finn for all the information he had on his site certainly helped tremendously in making choices and geared with prior information to ask Installers questions when making site visits.

This installation was for my investment property. My tenant is very happy with the decision. Every time I see the panels on the roof, I am reminded about Australia’s potential as a renewable energy powerhouse. Let’s do it…. for everybody.

My experience with Green Choice was very pleasing.Greg was genuine to deal with and quoted me a good price with Fronius inverter and Jinko panels.The installation was very quick, completed in half a day and operating well.
Liked that Green Choice electrical actually installs the system itself so one company is responsible for the entire job if anything goes wrong

The team at Green Choice Electrical did a great job installing our system. They answered all our questions after receiving the quote and provided enough information to make an informal decision to go ahead

Quote arrived promptly. It was clearly laid out. It did not include reams of marketing hype that were with the other three quotes I received.Spoke with Greg a few days later. He did not try to push a sale on me but would quote any system while stating "you don't need this".Installation was moved one day at he installers request and I was fine with that. Perth was having some stinking hot days and I wouldn't want to be on a roof in 42C.Installation had some pros and cons.I heard a noise outside my house and three lads were unloading a trailer and looking at my meter box.No one had knocked on the door when they arrived at the property.Without getting into specifics they could do with developing some social skills.My overall impression was they appeared to be rushed.I had to ask what was going to happen and the time frame for the installation.We did have a conversation about roof placement as it was an east west installation.With hindsight I'm unsure if the east facing panels are in the right place but time will tell.The placement and connections to the inverter is top class.I was disappointed to find remains of cable ties cut from the panels which were securing the connectors littering the front of the house.Probably more stars if they gave a few minutes when addressing the basics.

The quoting process was very fair and Greg was very prompt in relation to any questions I had about various system options.Installation was excellent.  Team were polite, efficient and  punctual.Greg organised grid connection prior to installation, the process was seamless
Happy with quoting, attention to detail.  Prompt and punctual.Ben and the installation team very organized and efficient.  They got the job done with minimal fuss.I would highly recommend them.
Green Choice Electrical responded promptly with a competitive quote with excellent customer service and the installation was fantastic.

The quotation process was good and the choice of what could be supplied flexible.The installation was good except for one minor error which is being rectified.My only negative in this install was that the installer who was an REC certified Installer didn’t know how to demonstrate registration  of warranty for the 25yr product warranty. It took a phone call to REC in Sydney to fix the issue. In addition the installer (CEC registered) didn’t initially offer to supply the documentation required under Sect5 of the CEC guidelines. This is now being rectified.Would recommend the company from an installation perspective but ensure you insist on all documentation.

From first contact with Greg from Green Choice electrical in Perth the experience was first class. The comprehensive quote arrived within 24 hours and the site visit within a couple of days. Greg was responsive in addressing all my questions and adjusting the components within the original quoted price - which was very competitive with the second company that quoted. Once we agreed to proceed Greg organised all the required paperwork and the new digital meter was installed well before the installation on Dec 8. Ben and his team arrived at the appointed hour and the installation went without a glitch. The team were efficient and very clean - and the work seemed to my inexpert eye to be first class. Within 4 hours the system was generating 5Kw and I was able to verify this from the App Ben assisted in setting up on my phone. Would have no hesitation recommending Green Choice to others seeking a smooth process.

Very happy with Greg and his team.  All aspects of the installation proceeded like clockwork and the team were super helpful.  Customer service was excellent, even after installation and payment, and the team was happy to come back and make a small system adjustment at my request.
I appreciated that their quoting process was brief - no hour-long spiel, just a simple "here's what we can do and here's the price".

The sales process was good. There were follow up phone calls to discuss options. I got several amended quotes for various designs and system sizes. The new smart meter was installed by the electricity supplier weeks before the install. The install occurred on the day booked and was quick, probably about 3 hours for our single storey Colourbond roofed house. The system was hooked up to the grid and functioning when the guys left. There was a small issue on the house that needed repair and Green Choice have been very responsive to get that sorted.

I wanted to deal with the people supplying, installing and commissioning the system. Greg (and his son) from Green Choice visited the site, answered my questions and provided a competitive quote for good quality equipment. The installation went to plan, on time, quick and tidy. They were obviously experienced and knowledgeable. I watched and hovered around during the installation. Very polite and informative crew. They removed the old PV system and left the site very clean and tidy. They did all the paperwork for the grid connection. I would highly recommend them and have done to one of my neighbours.

The quote came very quickly and was very detailed. No visit of the site was done prior to submitting the quote or the installation.Installation was delayed with two days due to unavailability of one of the team members, but when it was done was very efficient. The only negative fact is that a slab of granite used to keep a door open was smashed during the installation.
Easy, no hassle process. Quality and careful install on a very old terracotta tiled roof
Quick and efficient.Very good communication and after sales service  eg with app

Quotes and Emails:-I started with a bunch of questions for Greg, he answered them all in great detail and organized a time to visit. He was very friendly and helpful, and gave me quotes for the half dozen panels I was interested in. After receiving my quotes, it was a toss up between a much larger company and Green Choice. The quotes from Green Choice were cheaper and for better quality systems than the other company, on top of Greg seeming a lot more reputable and honest. Ratings for both were about the same and very high. Very glad I chose Green Choice. Greg was communicative and upfront the entire process, and was flexible regarding some delays with the roof restoration we had done just before. There was one slight hiccup with the supplier no longer stocking the panel I wanted at the last minute (out of their control), but Greg gave me a call and offered an upgrade to the new model for a discount, so it worked well for me. Excellent customer service.-Installation: Greg's son Ben showed up exactly on time, very friendly and polite and got the job done well in just a few hours. He helped me set up the app and put the inverter right where I wanted it. I made a couple requests with regards to panel placement (as many panels as possible in a small north facing area) and he was accommodating. Overall, he did an amazing job, with no issues whatsoever.-Overall: I would honestly rate this company 10/10, they exceeded my expectations at every stage and seem to be a very reputable and honest company while also offering the best systems for the lowest price, no idea how they do it but I'll take it. After contacting about a dozen solar companies over the past few years and not feeling quite sure about them, I'm glad solarquotes recommended these guys. I'll be recommending them to all my family members without solar. Thanks so much Greg and Ben!
Excellent service and friendliness. Excellent workmanship. No deposit required. Prompt installation time and done inside a morning.
Good customer service and insulation. Always replied to email and text. Fast smooth install. I would use again

Very easy to deal with. Prompt quoting and very happy to answer all my questions. Very quick and tidy installation. Grid installation was arranges and done prior to solar installation. Very quick and easy process the whole way.
Good service. Weather made installation a challenge. Supplier made everything work out well.

After checking with a few different installers we decided to go with Green Choice Electrical. They provided a fair first quote,  Greg was clear in what they could offer and provided quotes for a smaller and larger system.They were happy to provide options for different brands of inverters and panels and all at a good price.The install done by Ben was seamless and professional.  So I have only good feedback for entire team.Thanks!

Everything was made super easy by Greg and his installation team led by Greg's son, Ben. The guys were quick, efficient and careful. I can certainly recommend Green Choice for anyone in WA thinking of getting solar up and running. All I had to do was make the decision and Greg and Ben did the rest. Very professional and organised. Don't have any hesitation in contacting Green Choice - trust me, you will not be sorry.Thanks guys.
Ours was a slightly problematic installation due to being a three-storey home but the guys at Green Choice Electrical went out of their way to solve it.

After receiving quotes from various companies, green choice had the competitive price with the reputable brands listed on solar quotes.I contacted the ops manager and had many questions, he took the time to answer them all across my days of deciding. When ever I emailed or called, he got back to me as soon as he could with detailed information.The install process was seamless. Was given a date and time which the installers were on time, quick, efficient and tidy. It looked great when they were finished and proceeded to take the time to show me how to use the ap. After that, it was all working and haven’t had any dramas at all.
Salesman was very polite and well informed in his business. Installation was very quick clean and efficient. To date the system is working very well.

Our house was not the easy to do because of two story and the angle of the roof!!!  But the job was done well with good people doing the job!! No money up front even though I offered. We went for good non Chinese components and the system is working well.There a lot of cheats and fibbers in this business so one must be careful.
The entire process was really easy. It was nice to talk directly to the owner/installer rather than a sales rep.Great customer service all the way through.

After getting half a dozen quotes and doing a heap of research into solar energy systems and installers, I decided to go with Green Choice. They had great reviews and gave me the best quote (I got 6 quotes in all). Greg kept me informed about the progress of my installation and was very obliging and patient when discussing the various options for the system and the installation. He also arranged all the paperwork with the power company. I didn't need to do anything.On the day of the installation, Ben and the team turned up on time and quickly removed my existing  1.5KW system and replaced it with the 6.6 KW Fronius/Jinko system. I was impressed by how quickly and efficiently they worked to get the job done in 4 hours. They even hooked up one of my old panels so I could run it through another small inverter for keeping my camper trailer batteries charged. Despite me offering to pay for the additional work, Ben didn't want to be paid! Ben also set up the Fronius "Solar web" app on my phone (apparently it's a bit quirky to set up).I would highly recommend Green Choice to anyone in Perth looking for solar power. It's such a pleasure to deal with a company that looks after its customers. Thank you Greg and Ben.

Greg from Green Choice visited our home. He was polite and informed, happy to answer my many questions. Having done some research I had ideas on manufacturers. Greg was happy to update his quote to suit. The quote was very reasonable and far lower for the same thing than the other two providers. They removed our old solar hot water system from the roof without charge to make way for the panels. Others weren’t prepared to do that with charge.On install day, Ben and his team arrived. They were polite, and happy to consult with us on inverter placement. They were done within a few hours, site clean and tidy, install no fuss.System was working the same day.I recommend Green Choice for their personalised sales, customer and install service, and reasonable pricing. I felt they were honest and reliable.
Sales process was no nonsense and telling how it is.  Installation  was punctual, professional and very clean and tidy. Grid connection was easy as it was existing.

Great customer service and installation. Very happy with the quoting process, explained the benefits of the various systems and easy to select the combination we went with. Price was very competitive.

We recently had Green Choice Electrical install solar panels to our new home.  Greg provided great advice when selecting our products and quotations. Green Choice Electricals pricing was very competitive and I note that they were the only company I received a quote from that did not have an additional charge for two storey houses. The installation team arrived right on time and happily discussed options for locating our inverter. We were impressed with how tidy the team were, I noticed the care taken to not damage the colorbond and gutters when on our roof and installing the panels. After installation they provided assistance with setting up the monitoring system on our devices and connecting us appropriately. I would highly recommend this company.

Courteous, timely and information rich quotation and clarifications process.Good pricing on well known suppliersGood communication through the supply and installation.Good installation and setup of monitoring appA small but well established local company,with goof quality work and value for money.Would make this decision again.
Sales/quoting was very good and helpful.The installation completed on time with no problems. The company arranged everything nothing for me to do.
Installed efficiently and in a tidy manner. Had a few issues getting the smart meter to work properly which needed another visit but sorted within a couple of weeks.

We felt comfortable right from the start Green Choice were friendly and did not pressure us, they gave us great information on there systems and were fantastic to deal with. They always answered our questions and the installation went very smoothly highly recommended.
Two young men were all of the above ie polite, punctual and tidy.

I used Green Choice Electrical as my solar systems supplier and installer.They were knowledgeable and helpful and the system they quoted was the least expensive whilst using the highest rated combination of components.Installation was completed on time and they took the time to help me setup the iPhone App as well.I would highly recommend Ben and Greg to anyone in Perth.

Green Choice Electrical came back with a competitive and comprehensive quote, with panels, inverter, options, business details.We agreed an installation date. The team turned up at 7am on the day of installation, were totally professional, and had finished before 10am.When I asked about the grid connection, it had already been arranged with our electricity supplier, and the meter replaced. We were good to go from day 1!I had a follow up question about the mobile app to connect to the inverter, so the following Saturday they came by and sorted that out that issue.I would totally recommend these guys for their quality and professionalism.

Quoting process was informative, polite and non-pushy, and Greg was incredibly patient with my many questions. Wait time was reasonable, and the installation was smooth, tidy and stress free. Green Choice Solar come highly recommended.

I had a choice of two companies.  After talking through my requirement on the phone, Green Choice came out early on a Sunday morning to so a site survey.  This was mandatory given the shape and aspect of my roof, and the 30m Tuart tree on the northern side of the boundary.  A quick inspection led to the answer in both capacity and installation plan, and the job was quoted within 24 hours.  On the appointed day, the installation team were on time and carried out the job in trying conditions (heat) efficiently and safely.  Within four hours the system was up and running.  At present I am very happy with the outcome.

I found throughout the process that Green Choice were the most engaged in the process and informative around what we needed and more importantly didn't need. Great knowledge of the product and technology and able to really make it easy to understand to make a really informed decision on which way to go.

I spent a lot of time researching which panels, which inverter, and which company would do the installation.  My studies of the (many) options led me to Green Choice, and with everything now installed and running smoothly I can say that this has been an excellent choice - no question.From initial inquiry to final completion of works their attention to detail and oversight has been impressive.  No pressure and no sales tactics. Solid advice as to your options. Rapid and intelligent responses to technical questions. A genuine care taken to listen to, and meet the customer’s needs.This family business is run by Ben with his father Greg, and I was very impressed that at my initial site visit I was meeting the person who would be leading the actual installation on the day. This was important to me, especially as I had found that other installers were not keen to do a pre-installation site visit. With other installers I also found that there were sometimes many layers of people between those who were selling you a product and those who actually get subcontracted to do the work.On the day, Ben and the work crew arrived on time, and were respectful and professional throughout. Their work was neat and tidy and the team clearly took pride in their work. Cables neatly routed, etc.  In short, the job was done properly and to a high standard.When something doesn’t quite work out as expected, this can be when you find out whether you made the right choice of installer. I had opted for Solar Analytics monitoring but the area I live in doesn’t see a very good 3G signal and data output was affected by this meaning a different solution needed to be found.
